page: Vultr vbm-256c-3072gb-8-mi325x-gpu is a bare-metal server configured with dual AMD EPYC 9575F processors operating at 3.3 GHz. The system provides 128 physical cores and 256 vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, backed by 3072.0 GB of system memory. This yields a memory allocation of 12.0 GB per core.

The server features eight AMD CDNA3 MI325X GPUs, delivering a combined total of 2048 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of 28608 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, providing high-speed local data access. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is included with the deployment.

Given the high density of AMD CDNA3 accelerators and massive system memory, this bare-metal configuration represents a highly consolidated hardware profile for large-scale parallel computing. The integration of local NVMe storage and high-capacity VRAM minimizes data transfer bottlenecks. This server is designed for large language model training, massive-scale AI inference, deep learning, and complex scientific simulations.
